## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (enforcement changes cover both the action and its audit record)
- [ ] `pytest` and `ruff check .` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Docs updated for any new permission, configuration key or audit event
- [ ] No real tenant data, names, emails or tokens anywhere in the change
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
